buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic Bidders are advised to check applicable GST on their own before quoting. Buyer will not take any responsibility in this regards. GST reimbursement will be as per actuals or as per applicable rates (whichever is lower), subject to the maximum of quoted GST %. 2. Generic Bidder shall submit the following documents along with their bid for Vendor Code Creation: a. Copy of PAN Card. b. Copy of GSTIN. c. Copy of Cancelled Cheque. d. Copy of EFT Mandate duly certified by Bank. 3. Generic Data Sheet of the product(s) offered in the bid, are to be uploaded along with the bid documents. Buyers can match and verify the Data Sheet with the product specifications offered. In case of any unexplained mismatch of technical parameters, the bid is liable for rejection. 4. Generic Manufacturer Authorization:Wherever Authorised Distributors/service providers are submitting the bid, Authorisation Form /Certificate with OEM/Original Service Provider details such as name, designation, address, e-mail Id and Phone No. required to be furnished along with the bid 5. Generic OPTION CLAUSE: The Purchaser reserves the right to increase or decrease the quantity to be ordered up to 50 percent of bid quantity at the time of placement of contract. The purchaser also reserves the right to increase the ordered quantity up to 50% of the contracted quantity during the currency of the contract at the contracted rates. The delivery period of quantity shall commence from the last date of original delivery order and in cases where option clause is exercised during the extended delivery period the additional time shall commence from the last date of extended delivery period. The additional delivery time shall be (Increased quantity ÷ Original quantity) × Original delivery period (in days), subject to minimum of 30 days. If the original delivery period is less than 30 days, the additional time equals the original delivery period. The Purchaser may extend this calculated delivery duration up to the original delivery period while exercising the option clause. Bidders must comply with these terms. 6. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses Product Catalogue to be uploaded along with your Quote. Operating / User Manual and necessary certificates along with Accessories as indicated in the technical specification sheet to be supplied along with the item.

The Item to be supplied complying all the parameters and requirements as indicated in the Technical Scope of Work & Compliance sheet which is attached herewith this bid. S upply Subject to inspection and acceptance of Equipment at Buyer's site. In the event of an order, 100% payment will be made within 45 days of receipt, accepta nce of Installation and commissioning of Equipment/s by RTGS or any other latest Electr onic Payment remittance mode. Standard warranty of 12 months from the date of acceptance of items at HAL. Supplier shall be responsible for defects arising due to faulty materials, design, or workmanship, and shall remedy such defects at their own cost when notified by HAL. Replacement or r enewal of defective portions shall be carried out without extra cost to HAL. During warra nty, minimum uptime of 95% must be ensured; failing which, the warranty period shall be proportionately extended. Equipment shall be repaired/replaced free of cost during w arranty, including any to & fro freight/insurance involved. Liquidated Damages: If the Seller fails to deliver any or all of the Goods/Services within t he original Delivery period specified in the Contract, the Buyer will be entitled to deduct /recover the Liquidated Damages for the delay, @ 0.5% per week or part of the week of delayed period as pre-estimated damages not exceeding 10% of the contract value. Supply of new / replacement goods. Any Customs duty, taxes & other charges involved f or replacement goods etc.… has to be borne by Seller only. Such amount will be recove red from pending bills (of any division of HAL) / Seller has to transfer such specified amo unt as per HAL intimation to HAL designated bank account within specified time limits, f ailing which appropriate action as deemed fit shall be taken by HAL without further noti ce. In case of rejections and return, the supplier has to bear the cost of transportation inclu ding return of rejected goods and the rejected goods have to be collected back from HA L premises / arrangements to be made by Seller with proper authorization. As part of ISO45001:2018, HAL insists the Seller to comply with all the applicable Health and safety laws and regulations as per Indian factories act-1948. As part of ISO14001:2015, HAL insists the Seller to comply with all the applicable Enviro nmental laws and regulations as a minimum to Pollution control board requirements as applicable. The Seller or third interested party should make efforts to adhere to the Envi ronment, Health and Safety (EHS) requirements as per applicable standards. HAL, its Customers and Regulatory Authorities have the right to access Seller’s manufac turing facilities or of Seller’s sub-contractors and verify the process with respect to orde red materials and related record with respect to QMS adopted to contract the manufact uring process. Order is governed by GeM Terms and Conditions of Contract. In case of ambiguity, the a dditional terms and conditions of the bid document shall prevail. Agency Visit is a mandatory requirement for all bidders. Vendors must visit HAL Overhaul Division during working hours (7:00 AM to 3:00 PM on working days) to unders tand the scope and technical requirements related to the adapter, loadcell, and display unit. During this visit, the Agency Visit Form will be provided, which must be duly filled and submitted along with the bid. Bids submitted without the completed Agency Visit Fo rm will be rejected without exception. For visit coordination and security clearance, vendors must contact the following official s:
